extraction_notes: Midgam (Mano Geva) for Channel 12 News, fieldwork 31/8/2026, phone + internet, stratified random sampling. Initial sample 500; 2,502 asked; 506 responded (20%); 1,996 refused/unfit (80%); max sampling error +/-4.4%. All four vote tables carry the footnote that raw figures do not include allocation of undecideds. Pages 6-8: PM suitability head-to-heads (with 'previous polls' tables), coalition/unity-government questions for coalition and opposition voters - not extracted.
